annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/681 of 8 April 2025 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1182 as regards harmonised standards for medical gloves for single use, sterilization of medical devices and patient handling equipment used in ambulances
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/681 of 8 April 2025 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1182 as regards harmonised standards for medical gloves for single use, sterilization of medical devices and patient handling equipment used in ambulances
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision adding six harmonised standards (medical gloves, sterilization, powered ambulance stretchers and chairs) to the list supporting the Medical Devices Regulation (EU) 2017/745, conferring presumption of conformity upon publication of references in the Official Journal.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends Annex of Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1182 with entries 27-32.
Compliance gives presumption of conformity with Regulation (EU) 2017/745.
Enters into force on day of publication.
Cites CJEU C-588/21 P on public access to harmonised standards.
